scenarios.title: LCB mixed liquids - Brine / Water / Oil
scenarios.purpose: Three 224 x 120 compartments hold Brine (whole cell), Water (mass8 full cells around an 8 x 8 Salt strip) and Oil (whole cell). Salt dissolves into Brine on Water contact from tick 0. All three full-height gates are erased at tick 30, producing a lock exchange into a dry runout: Brine undercuts Water, Oil rides over it. Under Current defaults this exercises freemass_v1 and cellular_yield_v1 only; the three-family overlay needs LCB-005 and the pressure substitution needs LCB-001.
